coverage.means: CPU-ONLY is a refusal and is sound: no upstream node is ours. EP-COVERED is the weaker inference and only ever withholds MATCH, never grants it. Without a claim log the EP-COVERED side is nearly uninformative on a real model, because ORT's own optimisers delete node events wholesale.

reasons.out_claimed: 4 of 4 upstream node(s) may be ours (claimed_add, claimed_mul, claimed_mul2, claimed_sub): no other-provider event, so absorbed into a fused island or eliminated before execution — this label withholds MATCH, it does not grant it
reasons.out_declined: none of the 3 upstream node(s) is ours — each either carries an explicit other-provider event; nothing this EP ran reaches this output, so its oracle comparison is CPU-against-CPU

what_this_is: the intermediate-ledger state: some nodes claimed, some declined, one output behind each. CPU-ONLY is a refusal and is sound; EP-COVERED is the weaker inference and only ever withholds MATCH.
